paper_metadata.title: Revisiting Pre-Trained Models for Chinese Natural Language Processing
paper_metadata.abstract: Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) has shown marvelous improvements across various NLP tasks, and consecutive variants have been proposed to further improve the performance of the pre-trained language models. In this paper, we target on revisiting Chinese pre-trained language models to examine their effectiveness in a non-English language and release the Chinese pre-trained language model series to the community. We also propose a simple but effective model called MacBERT, which improves upon RoBERTa in several ways, especially the masking strategy that adopts MLM as correction (Mac). We carried out extensive experiments on eight Chinese NLP tasks to revisit the existing pre-trained language models as well as the proposed MacBERT. Experimental results show that MacBERT could achieve state-of-the-art performances on many NLP tasks, and we also ablate details with several findings that may help future research. Resources available: https://github.com/ymcui/MacBERT

extraction_data.innovation: Whole Word Masking (WWM) combined with N-gram masking: selects candidate tokens for masking using word-level unigram to 4-gram with percentages 40%, 30%, 20%, 10%; improves upon standard token-level masking by preserving word boundaries and capturing full word semantics. ; MLM Correction (MacBERT): replaces the [MASK] token with similar words (80% similar, 10% random, 10% original) instead of masking with [MASK]; eliminates the pre-post training mismatch caused by the [MASK] token appearing in pre-training but not in fine-tuning. ; Sentence Order Prediction (SOP): replaces Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) with a task that predicts whether two sentences are in the correct order; better captures sentence-level relationships and avoids the triviality of NSP.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Chinese Wikipedia (0.4B words), extended training data (5.4B words: encyclopedia, news, QA web)
extraction_data.hardware_used: Google Cloud TPU v3-8, TPU Pod v3-32
extraction_data.extension: Replaces 80% of masked tokens with similar words and 10% with random words to transform MLM into a language correction task, reducing pre-training/fine-tuning discrepancy.
extraction_data.application: Sentiment classification, news genre classification, reading comprehension, sentence pair classification
extraction_data.paper_title: Revisiting Pre-Trained Models for Chinese Natural Language Processing
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Eight Chinese NLP tasks (machine reading comprehension, text classification, etc.), CMRC2018, DRCD, CJRC, XNLI, LCQMC, BQCorpus, CMRC 2018, ChnSentiCorp, THUCNews
extraction_data.hardware_description: Cloud TPU access via Google TensorFlow Research Cloud (TFRC)
extraction_data.training_environment_scale: Single TPU v3-8 or TPU Pod v3-32
extraction_data.benchmark_result: CMRC2018 Dev EM/F1: 70.7/68.6, Test EM/F1: 88.9/88.2, Challenge EM/F1: 74.8/73.2; DRCD Dev EM/F1: 91.2/90.8, Test EM/F1: 95.6/95.3, Challenge EM/F1: 91.7/90.9; CJRC Dev EM/F1: 62.4/61.3, Test EM/F1: 82.3/81.4, Challenge EM/F1: 62.9/61.6; Performance varies by masking strategy: Random Replace ~74.5, Partial [MASK] ~73.5, All [MASK] ~72.5 (ME metric); ChnSentiCorp Test: 95.7(95.0); THUCNews Test: 97.9(97.7); XNLI Test: 81.3(80.6); LCQMC Test: 90.6(90.3); BQCorpus Test: 86.2(85.7)
